newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit stays in tight range in dull market.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit stays in tight range in dull market.

text.p: The ringgit traded in a 20-point range for most of the Asian day on market reluctance to indulge regional currencies in the absence of any strong news support, dealers said on Monday.
They said the ringgit was unaffected by the strong dollar/mark.
"There is nothing new to report today. There were no big players and no incentives to trade," said a dealer with a Singapore-based U.S. bank.
He said an attempt by ringgit to break out of the range was being stumped by low volumes and the strong dollar.
"Late in London on Friday there was some ringgit/Sing play which prevented dollar/ringgit from rising any further," a dealer with a Malaysian bank in Kuala Lumpur said.
He said dollar/ringgit was still expected to move upward in the near- and medium-terms.
"But, it should remain in a range today, unless it breaks above 2.5295," another local bank dealer said.
At 0930 GMT, the ringgit was at 2.5268/75 a dollar against 2.5275/85 at close of Kuala Lumpur on Friday. It traded between 2.5270 and 2.5290.
